sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border E-Commerce Overseas Warehouse Order Fulfillment

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law — corporate statute modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law (Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended); customary/traditional law recognized under Article III of the RMI Constitution for land and social matters only; non-resident Business Corporations are wholly governed by the BCA 1990.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (Title II — economic relations and investment facilitation provisions)
Agreement on the Establishment of the World Trade Organization (RMI accession effective 15 December 2021; MFN and TRIMS disciplines)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus — regional trade in goods and services)
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement network exists for the Marshall Islands; inbound protection is derived from the instruments above.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (Title 27, RMI Revised Code); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2021; AML/CFT Regulations 2021; FATF 40 Recommendations implemented through the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) membership; RMI Registrar of Corporations (Office of the Attorney General, Majuro) and RMI Financial Intelligence Unit administrative directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of valid international passport (each director, shareholder, UBO and authorized signatory)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport office / issuing authority of country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or financial institution of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming banking history and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sending or relationship bank of the principal

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing (if a corporate shareholder; issued within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution / written consent of corporate shareholder authorizing RMI incorporation and UBO disclosure
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or board of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (required where the home jurisdiction is not an Apostille Contracting State)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-onboarding screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and APG advisories; PEP determination per FATF Recommendation 12 definitions, with enhanced due diligence applied to PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions and unexplained source-of-funds cases; screening results are documented in the Registered Agent's client risk file, refreshed at least annually, and preserved for at least six years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Corporate Registry (Office of the Attorney General, Majuro) — filings and name reservations are submitted digitally by licensed Registered Agents through the RMI Corporate Registry e-Filing System; no direct public self-service portal is available.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in the Latin/Roman alphabet (English); no local script or transliteration is required. Names must be distinguishable from all registered, reserved or restored names and must end with a required suffix: 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', 'Company' or abbreviations thereof (Corp., Inc., Ltd., Co.), or 'Société Anonyme'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed Registered Agent immediately re-submits up to three alternative names in ranked order; the applicant may also file a formal administrative reconsideration request with the Registrar of Corporations within 30 calendar days of the rejection (no separate statutory fee). If the rejection is upheld, the applicant may apply to the RMI High Court for judicial review (writ of mandamus) within the applicable civil time limits. Where time-sensitive, incorporation may proceed under a neutral alternative name without awaiting appeal; no damages are claimable for a rejected name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted — the statutory registered office must be a physical RMI address provided by the licensed Registered Agent, but no operational staff or physical substance is required in the Marshall Islands for a non-resident, tax-exempt Business Corporation; the e-commerce cross-dock and overseas warehouse activity is performed entirely outside the RMI, and no RMI statutory license is required for the ISIC 5210 scope of business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Very low (<5% annualized probability during the first five years) — unannounced RMI inspections target licensed Registered Agents and are conducted by the RMI FIU or APG evaluation missions; cargo and packing facilities located outside the RMI are not subject to RMI Registry inspection; the business qualifies as low-risk standard for AML/CFT purposes under the stated target payment rails.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government name search and reservation fee (per proposed name)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff — published RMI fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee (authorized capital up to USD 100,000; standard non-expedited)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff — Business Corporations Act 1990 fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed Registered Agent and registered office service (first annual term)
Client onboarding, KYC/AML/UBO file compilation, PEP and OFAC/UN sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per AML/CFT Act 2021 compliance obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate document kit (Articles of Incorporation, Bylaws, share certificates, company seal and apostilled/certified copies)
Notarization and Hague Apostille for full KYC document bundle (three principals, five documents each)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public and Competent Apostille Authority (country of origin) or RMI Consulate where consular legalization applies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (USD 50–100 per document set plus apostille fees)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International courier for execution, legalization and delivery of incorporation documents

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (BCA) 1990, Title 36 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code; Sections 48 (Incorporators), 49 (Filing of Articles of Incorporation), 50 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 57 (Bylaws), 66 (Action by Directors Without Meeting), and 97 (Certificate of Correction)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (administered in coordination with licensed RMI Registered Agents and the Ministry of Finance fee schedule)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (filed on the official registrar form with a notarized signature page; issuance of Certificate of Incorporation upon approval)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required. The BCA permits par value as low as US$0.001 per share; capital may remain unpaid at formation, and no escrow or deposit account is mandated for a non-resident Business Corporation. Consideration for issued shares must be recorded in the corporate books before share certificates are delivered.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the subscription of 1,000 ordinary voting shares of US$1.00 par value issued to the incorporators, and consideration is declared fully received. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be established at the licensed agent's address in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the registered agent named in the Articles is confirmed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Director A], [Director B], and [Director C] are appointed as initial Directors with full powers to elect officers and adopt Bylaws. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the corporate secretary is directed to file all instruments required under the Business Corporations Act and to certify this resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI (processed through a licensed RMI Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability request through a licensed registered agent. The proposed name must end with 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an approved abbreviation and must be distinguishable from existing register entries. Upon clearance, the name is reserved for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name in English
Statement of primary business purpose (ISIC 5210 cross-border e-commerce fulfillment and 3PL warehousing)
Identity particulars of the incorporators
Registered agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or prohibited terms, file two alternate names on the same application; the reservation may be renewed once for an additional 60-day period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (RMI or recognized foreign equivalent) and licensed RMI Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation under BCA Sections 49 and 51, including corporate name, registered office in Majuro, registered agent, corporate purpose covering warehousing and logistics, share structure, and incorporator names. Each incorporator executes the Articles and acknowledges signature before a notary.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Incorporation
Name reservation certificate
Certified passport copy of each incorporator
Signed consent of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent or Registrar pre-files a query, revise the deficient clause, re-execute the signature page, and re-notarize without payment of a second government filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Articles and Payment of Statutory Filing Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI (Ministry of Finance fee schedule)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Articles in duplicate with the Registrar together with the US$275 government fee for up to 10,000 authorized shares. Fees are remitted by wire from the agent's trust account; an expedited 24-hour review may be selected for a premium fee.
required_dossiers: Original notarized Articles of Incorporation and signed duplicate
Government filing fee remittance (US$275 base or expedited amount)
Cover letter from the registered agent
Power of attorney appointing the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a rejection memo, cure the cited defects within 15 business days and resubmit; the original application date is preserved upon cure and payment of any deficiency fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Register Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar endorses the Articles, enters the Corporation in the national registry, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent retains a certified copy at the RMI office and confirms the statutory incorporation date, which governs all subsequent compliance deadlines.
required_dossiers: Approved Articles of Incorporation
Certificate of Incorporation
Registered agent acceptance certificate
Certified copy of the Articles for banking and counterparty use
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical or administrative errors, file a Certificate of Correction under BCA Section 97 within 20 days; the Registrar issues a corrected certificate without substantial penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Adoption of Bylaws, and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (internal governance; no government approval required for the organizational meeting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of incorporation, the directors hold an organizational meeting or execute a unanimous written consent under BCA Section 66. The board adopts Bylaws, elects President, Secretary, and Treasurer, approves share issuance, authorizes bank account opening, and records all actions in the minute book.
required_dossiers: Notice of organizational meeting or waiver of notice
Adopted Bylaws
Unanimous written consent of directors (if no meeting held)
Officer acceptance certificates and incumbency certificate
Share ledger and specimen stock certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director is unavailable, the meeting may validly proceed upon waiver by all directors; alternatively, a written consent signed by every director entitled to vote has the same force as a unanimous vote.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Registered Office, Corporate Records, and Post-Incorporation Compliance Tracking
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent and Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain the statutory registered office in Majuro and the licensed registered agent on record. Keep the corporate records book (minute book, share register, Articles, and Bylaws) at the agent's office, and calendar the annual non-resident fee and annual report filing to prevent administrative dissolution.
required_dossiers: Registered office address confirmation
Corporate records book (minute book, share register, Articles, Bylaws)
Registered agent service agreement
Annual fee and annual report compliance calendar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent resigns or ceases to be licensed, the Corporation must appoint a successor within 30 days; file the change of agent notice with the Registrar to avoid administrative dissolution or loss of good standing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licensing Office, RMI Ministry of Resources and Development, in coordination with the Majuro Atoll Local Government trade license desk
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License under the Business License Act 2007 — not required for a non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporation performing cross-dock fulfillment services outside RMI; the license becomes mandatory only upon establishment of a physical warehouse or a place of business in the Republic of the Marshall Islands

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 — Environmental Registration (minor facility) for warehousing and logistics operations under ISIC 5210; a full EIA Report is not triggered for dry-goods cross-dock operations unless the facility stores hazardous substances, fuel, or exceeds 4,000 square meters of floor area
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with RMI EPA wastewater discharge standards by receiving-water quality class, solid waste handling permits under EPA Waste Management Regulations, and stormwater runoff control plans; VOC and fuel storage registration thresholds apply only if the facility operates diesel generators or an owned vehicle fleet

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the RMI Fire and Rescue Services covering sprinkler coverage, hydrant access, and egress routes; structural load inspection certificate from the Ministry of Public Works for racking systems and mezzanine floors; occupational safety clearance under RMI Occupational Safety and Health standards for forklift traffic lanes, loading-dock edge protection, rack stability, and worker training records

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance and Treasury; online portal via the National Taxpayer Access System at https://rmitax.com (official practical portal for filings and business license tax)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must first obtain a Marshall Islands corporate charter from the Registrar of Corporations under the Registrar of Corporations Act. Thereafter, the entity files the completed application for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) with the Revenue and Taxation Division, together with the registered agent appointment and a copy of the certificate of incorporation. If the entity is a non-resident business corporation, a Foreign Investment Business License under the Foreign Investment Act is also required; the Revenue and Taxation Division then issues the statutory TIN and, where applicable, a Business License Tax permit. Non-resident entities without economic substance in the Marshall Islands are classified as tax-exempt business corporations and are not subject to local income tax or business license tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available because the Marshall Islands does not impose an entity-level income tax. The Business Corporation Act provides for a non-resident election: by designating the corporation as non-resident, the entity becomes exempt from Marshall Islands income tax and business license tax. No income tax treaty or hybrid-electronic classification regime applies. The entity may elect to be treated as a foreign sales or holding vehicle, but this has no income tax consequence. There is no local equivalent of the U.S. check-the-box regulations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT or GST; the Marshall Islands imposes only customs import and excise duties and a business license tax on resident commercial activities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — the Marshall Islands has no VAT, GST, or sales and use tax registration threshold. No turnover threshold triggers indirect tax registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping requirement exists under Marshall Islands law. Businesses are not required to transmit invoice data to the tax authority; however, all invoices must be retained as part of the business records required for Business License Tax and customs compliance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Because the Marshall Islands does not levy VAT or GST, the concept of export zero-rating is not statutorily recognized. Goods exported from the Marshall Islands are outside the scope of any national consumption tax and therefore no VAT is charged, regardless of origin or destination. No VAT refund claim mechanism exists. For customs purposes, the export must be made in accordance with the Customs Revenue Act and all applicable commodity export regulations.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Marshall Islands Customs and Trade Service form)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment evidence demonstrating receipt of foreign currency for the exported goods
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: As no VAT/GST zero-rating scheme exists, no fraudulent zero-rating clawback regime applies. However, false export declarations submitted to the Customs and Trade Service, or misdeclaration of goods or value to obtain any customs duty relief or export evidence, are subject to administrative penalties under the Customs Revenue Act, including monetary fines, forfeiture of goods, seizure of the cargo, and suspension or revocation of the entity's business license. Misrepresentation in any export document may also constitute an offense under the Criminal Code and carry imprisonment for individuals. Any customs duty relief previously granted may be immediately reassessed and recovered from the declarant with interest and penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) — no central bank exists; the United States Federal Reserve is the issuer of the circulating currency under the Compact of Free Association.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender and domestic currency. RMI maintains no exchange-control apparatus; both current-account and capital-account transactions are fully convertible. There is no statutory approval requirement for cross-border remittances and no withholding, QI reporting, or profit-repatriation tax imposed by RMI on non-resident Business Corporations. The only practical hurdles are U.S. correspondent banking compliance, OFAC sanctions screening, and the receiving bank's KYC/AML policies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. RMI imposes no export-proceeds surrender obligation for non-resident Business Corporations. There is no prescribed statutory timeline for repatriation, and the mandatory conversion ratio is zero because the U.S. dollar is the local currency. Export receipts may be retained in any USD account at home or abroad without central bank approval.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational / Current Account (USD, ACH and Wire)
Operational Account (USD demand deposit and SWIFT)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rated High for ancillary cross-border collection and disbursement, particularly Airwallex, which is consistent with the target payment rails. A foreign fintech EMI is not within the RMI Banking Act if it maintains customer accounts abroad and has no physical deposit-taking branch in RMI. There is no RMI regulatory licence for pure EMI activities, so onboarding is executed under a standard commercial contract, not a banking licence. The legal constraint is that such EMI cannot lawfully hold escrow or regulated deposits in RMI; all funds must remain in safeguarded accounts with licensed partner banks. Correspondent U.S. banks will impose enhanced due diligence on any RMI non-resident corporate that uses an EMI as a primary treasury rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Local commercial banks generally require at least one director or authorised signatory to appear physically at a Majuro or Ebeye branch for an in-person KYC interview before account opening. Remote opening is tolerated only when the applicant is already an existing customer of the bank's U.S. parent/correspondent network or when the account is held with a U.S. licensed institution using video KYC. RMI law does not statutorily guarantee remote onboarding; therefore the treasury implementation plan should include one director or compliance officer travelling to Majuro for the initial account-opening ceremony and for any subsequent UBO clarification interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% non-resident ownership and no physical office or employees in RMI
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, registered agent certificate, certificate of good standing, board resolution authorising account opening, notarised and apostilled passport copies of all directors and UBOs, audited financial statements, and a written explanation of the non-resident offshore structure and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shell/shell-risk flag due to lack of economic substance in RMI and a tax-exempt status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Third-party service agreements proving actual commercial activity, including overseas warehouse lease agreements, order-fulfilment contracts, freight forwarding and customs brokerage agreements, payroll records of operational staff overseas, annual audited financial statements, and a business plan mapping the cross-dock 3PL revenue chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual cross-border transaction pattern involving multiple third-party beneficiaries and high velocity e-commerce settlements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction-flow diagram, commercial invoices and purchase orders, bills of lading and customs declarations, internal order-fulfilment records, merchant-of-record contracts, sanctions screening logs, AML/CFT training certificates, and the appointment of a designated compliance officer for the corporate treasury function.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injections must be routed through a licensed commercial bank using SWIFT MT103 or, for U.S.-dollar domestic transfers, Fedwire/ACH. The receiving bank is the Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam – Majuro Branch with a short narrative in Field 70 such as 'EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION / CAPITAL INJECTION – NON-RESIDENT BC'. There is no RMI central bank filing or exchange-control code; the verifiable purpose code is the BOP/BPM6 'Direct Investment – Equity' classification. The corporate file must evidence the board resolution, share issuance certificate, UBO declaration, and source of funds statement; the bank will perform sanctions screening and PCR (positive customer review) before crediting the account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For low-value local disbursements, the Bank of Marshall Islands local ACH rail is used. For cross-border supplier payments, the primary rail is SWIFT MT103 with invoice numbers embedded in the remittance information field. For high-value inventory purchases or long-tenor supply contracts, an irrevocable documentary Commercial Letter of Credit (UCP600) will be issued by a licensed RMI commercial bank through its U.S. correspondent. Airwallex is used as a supplementary rail for small-value e-commerce payouts and merchant settlements, subject to U.S. OFAC screening and the platform's partner-bank safeguarding rules.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/EUR and USD/GBP vanilla deliverable forwards with OECD-licensed banking counterparties, executed offshore under ISDA documentation.
USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with HKMA- or MAS-regulated banks to hedge renminbi settlement exposure arising from Chinese e-commerce supply chains.
USD/EUR and USD/CNH cross-currency swaps for structural asset-liability and interest-rate risk management, subject to bilateral collateral and credit-support annexes.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Annual Franchise Tax under the Business Corporations Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-month rule: due on or before the last day of the calendar month in which the anniversary of incorporation falls, annually; no statutory extension is available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The Registrar may assess penalty charges on the unpaid franchise tax; if the tax remains unpaid for 60 days after the due date, the Registrar may administratively dissolve or strike the corporation off the register. Outstanding filings also block issuance of a Certificate of Good Standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (central non-public register) under the Marshall Islands beneficial ownership regulations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, submitted through the licensed resident agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-cycle re-confirmation at least once every 12 months, with a substitute update filing within 30 days of any shareholding transfer or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under the beneficial ownership regime; the entity is flagged as a delinquent filer, which suspends clean-standing certificates and may block acceptance of the annual report.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Notification and, if engaged, Economic Substance Report (conditional obligation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations (economic substance compliance function)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Notification aligns with the annual report cycle; any required report is due within 12 months after the financial year end. Applies only if the corporation is a Marshall Islands tax-resident entity carrying on a relevant activity, such as distribution and service centre activity.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalties and a formal non-compliance determination by the Registrar for failure to file; persistent non-compliance may be treated as grounds for administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a non-resident Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act. Mandatory independent audit arises only for entities licensed or regulated in banking, insurance, or trust business, or where the memorandum, articles, a shareholder resolution, or a lender or investor covenant requires audited accounts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory accounting standard for non-resident corporations; financial statements are commonly prepared under IFRS or US GAAP, and accounting records must be sufficient to show with reasonable accuracy the financial position and transactions of the corporation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed resident agent administers the centralized, non-public beneficial ownership register. Ultimate beneficial owners (persons holding 25% or more of shares or voting rights, or otherwise exercising control) must be re-confirmed at least once every 12 months on the annual-report anniversary; the agent files any change arising from a shareholding transfer or control shift with the Registrar within 30 days. The annual register audit reconciles the Register of Members, Register of Directors, and minute book against the confirmed beneficial ownership data before the annual report is filed.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$500–US$1,500 per annum (licensed resident agent and registered-office retainer in Majuro)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary certified audit for a small non-resident operations entity typically ranges from US$2,500 to US$5,500 per annum

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a non-resident Business Corporation deriving exclusively foreign-source income; the 3% Gross Revenue Tax (GRT) applies only to gross revenue from a trade or business actually conducted within the Marshall Islands, which is excluded under the target cross-dock overseas-3PL structure
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: N/A - the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act (1989) and Business Corporations Act impose no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or undistributed profits tax on non-resident BCs; no statutory tax holiday or preferential deduction is required because foreign-source income is outside the RMI tax net; effective rate remains 0% provided no RMI-source revenue, no local payroll, and no permanent establishment in the RMI arise

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: BC Annual Report (BCA s.117) filed by a locally-licensed Registered Agent via the Marshall Islands Corporate Registry e-filing portal; a non-resident BC with no RMI-source income is not required to file an RMI income tax return (Form GRT/IT-2 is inapplicable), but the Annual Report is mandatory for legal maintenance
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Report must be delivered to the Registrar during the calendar month of the corporation's anniversary of incorporation, and the annual franchise fee must be paid on or before the last day of that anniversary month; a newly incorporated BC files its first Annual Report in the anniversary month of the following year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the BC as shown in the Certificate of Incorporation, including any alternate name registration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the English-language legal name only; non-resident entities should verify name reservation consistency with the overseas warehouse trade name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique registration number assigned by the Registrar at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Obtain from last Certificate of Good Standing; required for online payment of annual fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Registered Office Address in the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, maintained by the Registered Agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident BCs cannot use a P.O. box; the address is supplied by the licensed Registered Agent and is publicly disclosable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Registered Agent Name and Address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and RMI business address of the licensed Registered Agent, an individual or corporation resident in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Keep agent details current; agent resignation with no replacement within 60 days triggers administrative dissolution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the entity's principal place of business, which may be outside the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For ISIC 5210 cross-dock fulfilment, enter the overseas warehouse or regional head-office address; this does not create RMI nexus.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Authorized Capital and Issued Shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total authorized share capital, par value per class, and number of issued and outstanding shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose exact UBO-linked share allocation; used to calculate the annual franchise fee tier (base USD 250 up to consideration tiers).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and usual residential or business addresses of all directors, the president, secretary, and treasurer or equivalent officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign nationals with non-RMI addresses are permitted; a register of directors must be kept at the registered office and filed in the Annual Report.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Date of the corporation's fiscal year-end.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select a practical year-end aligned with the overseas 3PL's home-country group reporting cycle (e.g., 31 December) for consolidated TP documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Manual or electronic signature of the secretary, assistant secretary, or a director certifying the accuracy of the report.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any director or officer may sign from abroad; the Registered Agent stamps the filing; false certification is a criminal offense.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of USD 500 plus a surcharge equal to the greater of USD 1,000 or 10% of the annual fee; continued non-compliance for 90 days after notice permits the Registrar to administratively revoke the Certificate of Incorporation; post-revocation trading renders directors personally liable and the BC is also subject to RMI criminal fines for failure to maintain an Annual Report under BCA s.117.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by a non-resident BC to any shareholder, whether resident or non-resident, and there is no branch remittance tax
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable - the Republic of the Marshall Islands maintains no comprehensive double tax agreement network; only limited bilateral maritime and aviation agreements exist. No Treaty Relief or TRC application is possible or needed for dividend flows because RMI-source withholding is absent. To evidence tax status to foreign counterparties, request a Certificate of Good Standing from the Registrar of Corporations; a Tax Residency Certificate is not issued by the RMI Revenue for a tax-exempt BC, and relying on a non-existent DTA is a compliance red flag.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory and effective WHT for cross-border IP royalties and debt interest: 0% for non-resident recipients; RMI law does not impose withholding on interest, royalties, or technical service fees paid by a non-resident BC, provided such income is not derived from an RMI trade or business.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No RMI Local File, Master File, or CbC reporting threshold exists under domestic law (the RMI is not in the OECD Inclusive Framework as a mandatory CbC exchange jurisdiction for non-financial MNEs). Nevertheless, where the BC is consolidated into a foreign group with revenue above the parent jurisdiction's CbC threshold (e.g., USD 850 million), the parent must file CbC in its tax-resident country; a contemporaneous Local File benchmark is commercially advisable when the BC invoices related-party fulfilment services, because the overseas-3PL jurisdiction may apply separate documentation thresholds.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has no general Economic Substance Regulations comparable to UAE ESR, but an anti-avoidance substance doctrine operates through the Income Tax Act source rules and the Business Corporations Act maintenance obligations: a foreign BC with no RMI office, employees, books, or management activity is treated as a pure exemption vehicle. The OECD Inclusive Framework membership (through the RMI's commitment to Base Erosion and Profit Shifting) and CRS/FATCA reporting obligations require the BC to maintain a registered office, a registered agent, share registers, director registers, and accounting records sufficient to reconstruct income. Critically, the economic substance of the cross-dock overseas-3PL is located in the warehouse's host jurisdiction; the RMI BC must not claim RMI substance for those activities or the host state may recharacterize the BC as a shell and deem a permanent establishment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The RMI BC invoices overseas-warehouse fulfilment fees into the RMI and declares no taxable income anywhere, while the cross-dock operations, local employees, inventory, and storage contracts in the destination country exceed that country's PE nexus threshold; excluding the local activity from local tax filings constitutes deliberate tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Destination-country penalties of up to 200% of underpaid corporate income tax, interest compounding, and criminal fines; in the RMI, BCA s.117 false annual report penalties and general criminal fines apply; the destination tax authority may levy VAT/GST fraud penalties of up to 100% of the non-paid output tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who directed the concealment face civil restitution orders, personal liability for the unpaid foreign tax under veil-piercing or director-statute theories, travel bans from the destination jurisdiction, extradition risk, and imprisonment (typically 5-10 years) for tax fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The BC has no registered-agent responsiveness, no books and records, no bank account in its own name, and no commercial reality; payments pass through the RMI entity purely as a booking artifice to mask the overseas 3PL principal, leading regulators to classify it as a shell corporation under FATF criteria.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative revocation of the Certificate of Incorporation, regulatory strike-off, and prohibition of the Registered Agent from continuing to represent the entity; the RMI Registrar may recommend criminal investigation; foreign courts may disregard the entity entirely and assess all profits at the true operating company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors incur personal liability for contracts signed during the post-revocation trading window, joint and several liability for fraudulent conveyance, and a 10-year ban from serving as director of any RMI entity; the RMI court may order assets tracing and freezing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Use of Local ACH, Airwallex, or wire rails to route merchant settlement flows through the BC without a suspicious-transaction reporting framework, absence of a beneficial-ownership record, or refusal to respond to Financial Intelligence Unit subpoenas when the 3PL funds are actually used for third-party settlement or pass-through payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Prevention of Money Laundering Act, fines up to USD 100,000 per violation, asset forfeiture, and revocation of any registered-agent license; administrative abrogation of the corporate charter; inclusion on international AML blacklists affecting correspondent banking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face up to 15 years' imprisonment for AML violations, personal confiscation orders equal to the funds laundered, travel bans, and removal from office; officers who knowingly signed false FIU responses are individually prosecutable.
